name: huginn
description: Huginn, Odin's raven of thought: matches model and effort to each step. Skills that set the effort for the rest of the turn without breaking the prompt cache (/huginn:deep, /huginn:quick, /huginn:max), Sonnet, Opus and Fable subagents for delegated work, a session-start policy that tells Claude when to use which, and a status-line chip with the active tier.
